name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 26 – Am 15
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 26b. Calls for the next MFF to strengthen investments in traceability, origin labelling, controls on imported products and anti-fraud technologies in the agri-food sector, in order to protect consumers, safeguard quality European production and ensure fair conditions of competition for European farmers;
